definitionZh: :host () CSS 假类函数选择包含其内部使用的 CSS 的阴影 DOM 的阴影主机(这样您就可以从它的阴影 DOM 内部选择一个自定义元素)——但前提是作为函数参数给出的选定器与阴影主机匹配. :host()在阴影DOM外使用时没有效果.
sourceDefinition: The :host() CSS pseudo-class function selects the shadow host of the shadow DOM containing the CSS it is used inside (so you can select a custom element from inside its shadow DOM) — but only if the selector given as the function's parameter matches the shadow host. :host() has no effect when used outside a shadow DOM.
